title: Honey Harvest Yield by Hive and Season
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beehive:reading event=harvest
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(harvest_kg) as honey by hive _time
| stats sum(honey) as total by hive
| sort - total
description: Totals the honey harvested from each hive across the season, revealing your strongest colonies and best-producing sites.
value: Comparing yield per hive guides which colonies to split and where to place hives, turning beekeeping into informed husbandry.
implementation: Log harvest weights into `index=personal`; schedule seasonally and total honey per hive.
visualization: Bar chart of honey harvested by hive.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up how much honey each hive produced, showing which of your colonies are the strongest.
